findings.summary: The previous GC reachability TOCTOU finding is resolved: GC now holds the task-scoped evidence mutation lock across final inventory revalidation and unlink, while evaluator evidence publication uses the same lock.
findings.broken_invariant: No invariant remains broken; concurrent AgentPlane evidence publication cannot make an object reachable inside the protected revalidation-to-unlink window.

evidence_refs.section: evidence-maintenance.ts, evidence-mutation-lock.ts, evaluator-review-usecase.ts, and concurrency tests

hidden_assumptions: All supported AgentPlane writers that publish evaluator manifests or their referenced objects participate in the shared task-scoped evidence mutation lock; arbitrary external filesystem writers remain outside the declared local maintenance trust model.
